hook: Cube projections have maximal entropy along equal-coordinate directions in every dimension from 150 up
summary: The paper proves that among one-dimensional projections of a uniform cube distribution, differential entropy is largest in directions whose coordinates have equal magnitude. This confirms a conjecture of Eskenazis, Nayar and Tkocz, but only for dimensions n of at least 150. Smaller dimensions remain open.
title: Entropy maximization for cube projections
